# FactRetriever

> > FactRetriever is a comprehensive fact database covering history, science, geography, health, and human behavior with research-backed articles.

Founded by Karin Lehnardt and James Israelsen, FactRetriever provides curated factual content spanning world history, natural disasters, global health statistics, human sexuality, cultural traditions, and scientific phenomena. The site organizes information into accessible, fact-based articles covering topics from ancient pandemics to modern demographics.

## Key Topics

- Karin Lehnardt (founder)
- James Israelsen (founder)
- Global health and pandemics
- Human sexuality and relationships
- World geography and cultures
- Historical events and figures
- Natural disasters
- Demographics and ethnicity
- Disease statistics
- Cultural traditions
- Planetary science
- Public health
- Medieval history
- Family relationships
- Human anatomy and physiology

## Health & Medicine

- [60 Facts about the Flu and Pandemics](https://www.factretriever.com/flu-facts): Influenza, COVID-19, pandemic history, and WHO disease statistics
- [Top 10 Causes of Death Worldwide](https://www.factretriever.com/top-10-causes-of-death): Global mortality statistics: heart disease, stroke, respiratory infections
- [Top 10 Health and Fitness Facts](https://www.factretriever.com/top10-healthfitness): Top 10 list covering nutrition, weight loss, wellness, and cooking
- [Interesting Pregnancy Facts](https://www.factretriever.com/pregnancy-facts): Maternal health, reproduction, and human biology from conception to birth

## History & Historical Figures

- [42 Interesting Black Death Facts](https://www.factretriever.com/black-death-facts): Medieval Europe's bubonic plague pandemic from 14th century
- [59 Terrifying Facts about Joseph Stalin](https://www.factretriever.com/joseph-stalin-facts): Soviet dictator's life, Great Purge, WWII, and USSR communist history
- [Crazy Infamous Figures Facts](https://www.factretriever.com/infamous-figure-facts): Notorious historical figures including serial killers and politicians

## World Geography & Cultures

- [58 Surprising India Facts](https://www.factretriever.com/india-facts): India's culture, history, geography, Hinduism, and traditions
- [41 Iceland Facts, Land of Fire and Ice](https://www.factretriever.com/iceland-facts): Vikings, volcanoes, Leif Erikson, and Icelandic culture & language
- [54 Interesting Hungary Facts](https://www.factretriever.com/hungary-facts): Budapest, Magyar language, thermal baths, and Hungarian traditions
- [Interesting Ethnicity Facts](https://www.factretriever.com/ethnicity-facts): Facts about race, Native Americans, immigration, and ethnic diversity

## Social Issues & Human Behavior

- [40 Interesting Facts about Hate Crimes](https://www.factretriever.com/hate-crime-facts): Bias-motivated crimes legislation, civil rights, and protected classes
- [Relationship Facts About Love, Family & Dating](https://www.factretriever.com/relationship-facts): Facts about love, family, dating, birth order, and human attraction
- [84 Thought-Provoking Orgasm Facts](https://www.factretriever.com/orgasm-facts): Sexual health facts covering orgasm physiology and human sexuality
- [23 Titillating Oral Sex Facts](https://www.factretriever.com/oral-sex-facts): Sexual behavior history from ancient Pompeii and Kamasutra to modern stats

## Natural Disasters & Science

- [49 Interesting Tsunami Facts](https://www.factretriever.com/tsunami-facts): Natural disasters, earthquake-triggered ocean waves, and coastal safety
- [31 Jupiter Facts: Surprising Secrets About the Giant Planet](https://www.factretriever.com/jupiter-facts): Jupiter's size, Great Red Spot, Galilean moons, and planetary science
